How day of the week is calculated

Determine the weekday for a valid Gregorian calendar date and show its ISO weekday number. The date is validated before calculation, so impossible dates such as February 30 are rejected rather than normalized into March. 2024-02-29 was a Thursday, ISO weekday 4. The calculation validates each input and keeps its stated units explicit. It uses the proleptic Gregorian calendar; historical local calendars may differ. This is an estimate for the stated assumptions; confirm measurements and any applicable professional or local standards before relying on it.

Day of the Week Calculator is calculated from the supplied measurement fields using the units shown.

Assumptions & useful context

The result depends on the values you enter and the method described above. Displayed numbers may be rounded; calculations use the unrounded values. Check that this model matches your situation before relying on it.

What is ISO weekday numbering?
